units.source_text: 命妇在正殿[\[11\]](#part1330.html#m11)南面下车。

en.t: The lady-in-waiting got down from her carriage on the south side of the main hall.

units.source_text: 太君接见，一时悲从中来，哽咽不能言语，好容易启口：

en.t: When the old lady received her, grief suddenly welled up within her; she choked back sobs and could not speak, and only with difficulty did she open her mouth:

units.source_text: “妾身苟延残喘，真乃薄命之人。

en.t: I have merely dragged out this poor life; truly I am a woman of wretched fate.

units.source_text: 猥蒙圣眷，有劳冒霜犯露，驾临蓬门，教人不胜愧感！”

en.t: To receive such undeserved imperial favor, and to trouble you to brave frost and dew to come to my humble gate, fills me with more shame and gratitude than I can bear!

units.source_text: 说罢，泪下如雨。

en.t: When she had said this, tears fell from her like rain.

units.source_text: 命妇答道：

en.t: The lady-in-waiting replied:

units.source_text: “前日典侍来此，回宫复奏，言此间光景，伤心惨目，教人肝肠断绝。

en.t: The other day, when the naishi came here and then returned to the palace to report, she said that the scene here was so heartbreaking and pitiful that it could tear one's heart apart.

units.source_text: 我乃冥顽无知之人，今日睹此情状，亦觉不胜悲戚！”

en.t: Even I, dull and ignorant as I am, saw this condition today and found the sorrow more than I could endure!

units.source_text: 她踌躇片刻，传达圣旨：

en.t: She hesitated for a moment, then conveyed the imperial message:

units.source_text: “万岁爷说：

en.t: His Majesty said:

units.source_text: ‘当时我只道是做梦，一直神魂颠倒。

en.t: At the time, I thought it was only a dream, and my mind remained utterly distraught.

units.source_text: 后来逐渐安静下来，然而无法教梦清醒，真乃痛苦不堪。

en.t: Later I gradually grew calmer, yet I could not make the dream clear away, and the pain was truly unbearable.

units.source_text: 何以解忧，无人可问。

en.t: How I might ease this grief, there is no one I can ask.

units.source_text: 拟请太君悄悄来此一行，不知可否？

en.t: I would like to ask the old lady to come here quietly for a visit; I do not know whether that would be possible.

units.source_text: 我又挂念小皇子，教他在悲叹哭泣之中度日，亦甚可怜。

en.t: I am also anxious about the little prince; to let him pass his days in grief and tears is truly pitiful.

units.source_text: 务请早日带他一同来此。

en.t: Please, by all means, bring him here with you as soon as possible.

units.source_text: ’万岁爷说这番话时，断断续续，饮泪吞声；又深恐旁人笑他怯弱，不敢高声。

en.t: When His Majesty said these words, he spoke brokenly, swallowing his tears and stifling his voice; fearing deeply that others would laugh at his weakness, he did not dare speak aloud.

units.source_text: 这神情教人看了实在难当。

en.t: That expression of his was truly more than anyone could bear to see.

units.source_text: 因此我不待他说完，便退出来了。”

en.t: For that reason, I withdrew before waiting for him to finish speaking.

units.source_text: 说罢，即将皇上手书呈上。

en.t: After saying this, she immediately presented the Emperor's handwritten letter.

units.source_text: 太君说：“流泪过多，两眼昏花，今蒙宠赐宸函，眼前顿增光辉。”

en.t: The old lady said, I have shed so many tears that both my eyes are dim, but now that I have been favored with this imperial letter, everything before me has suddenly grown bright.

units.source_text: 便展书拜读：

en.t: Then she opened the letter and reverently read it:
